subject: general
question: If the area of the triangle whose vertices are (3, -2), (2, -3) and (P, -4) is 8 square units, then find the value of p.
solution:
**Given:**

The vertices of the triangle are (3, -2), (2, -3), and (P, -4).

Area of the triangle is 8 square units.

**Formula used:**

Area of a triangle = 1/2 × | x₁(y₂ - y₃) + x₂(y₃ - y₁) + x₃(y₁ - y₂) |

**Calculations:**

Using the formula:

8 = 1/2 × | 3(-3 + 4) + 2(-4 + 2) + P(-2 + 3) |

⇒ 8 = 1/2 × | 3(1) + 2(-2) + P(1) |

⇒ 8 = 1/2 × | 3 - 4 + P |

⇒ 8 = 1/2 × | -1 + P |

⇒ 16 = | -1 + P |

⇒ -1 + P = 16 or -1 + P = -16

⇒ P = 17 or P = -15

**∴ The correct answer is option (2) 17.**
